title: Report basis-relative task-sync conflicts within a bounded diagnostic payload
outcome: A stale-basis refusal names actual locally diverged tasks and provides bounded evidence of both sides without filling the diagnostic with incoming-only changes.
acceptance: Incoming-only edits do not crowd actual local divergence out of the reported conflict set
Large task text and notes have a documented byte-bounded diagnostic with explicit omitted counts and a supported route to both full inputs
Behavioral tests include more than20 incoming-only edits before a genuine local divergence and large note bodies
